thread:
anna: heads-up — release pipeline failed to update tag for service-auth. deploybot blocked promotion. image pushed but ECR rejected tag overwrite due to immutable-tag policy. image digest: sha256:ff34aa22...

ci-bot: Build finished. Push attempt to 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/service-auth:release-20260322 returned 412 Precondition Failed (Tag immutability). Full push log: /artifacts/ci/1234/push.log

deploy-bot: Promote aborted: target tag `release-20260322` not pointing to verified digest. Registry rejected tag rewrite (immutable tag policy). Audit ref: promote-1751000000.

ryan: wait did another job opportunistically use the same tag? we added uniqueness last sprint but looks like a scheduled nightly grabbed the same tag.

ci-bot: Yep, nightly job #9823 re-used `release-20260322` as a short-lived mirror tag for internal testing at 12:03 PT. It pushed before the main CI completed. ECR policy disallows overwriting, so main push succeeded as digest-only but tag assignment failed.

ops-oncall: So we have a digest in the registry but the tag points at the nightly digest. Deploybot will refuse to promote a tag that doesn't match the expected digest from the release job. Options: 1) ask registry team to temporarily unset immutability (not ideal) 2) retag with a new unique release tag and promote that 3) manual pin promotion to digest (override) 4) rollback the canary schedule.

release-manager: prioritize minimal user impact. We prefer 2 or 3. If we retag we must ensure cross-region replication to eu-west/asia completes before traffic shift; that may add ~10-15 minutes. Pinning digest is faster but harder to trace in release notes.

anna: i'm leaning to retag -> consistent naming convention: release-20260322+1 (plus1) then update release metadata and CI to avoid reuse. Also file a hotfix to make CI append buildid to tags.

ryan: i'll create the retag and push attestation. command I'll run from infra bot host: 
```
aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name service-auth --image-ids imageDigest=sha256:ff34aa22... --region us-west-2 \
  | jq -r '.images[0].imageManifest' > manifest.json
aws ecr put-image --repository-name service-auth --image-tag release-20260322+1 --image-manifest file://manifest.json --region us-west-2
cosign sign --key ksm://projects/redwood/registry/service-auth --attachment attestations release-20260322+1
```

ci-bot: Note: put-image will create the tag pointing to the known manifest/digest. We'll then run the normal promote flow.

deploy-bot: Reminder: promote will still verify provenance labels + attestation. If the attestation isn't present in replication regions yet, promote may delay.

anna: go ahead ryan. I'll open the change window and notify #customers-notify that we may have a short delay due to replications. Change window: 15:30-15:45 PT.

ryan: Running retag now. output: `PutImage succeeded: repository=service-auth tag=release-20260322+1 digest=sha256:ff34aa22...`

ryan: Attestation pushed. Waiting on replication (us-west-2 -> eu-west-1). Estimated propagation ~12 minutes.

deploy-bot: Promote attempt blocked until attestation verified in target region caches. Next automatic recheck in 60s.

ops-oncall: I'll keep a monitor on replication lag. If propagation exceeds 20m we'll switch to manual digest pin and abort the retag promotion.

release-manager: I've drafted release note entry: "service-auth release-20260322 retagged to release-20260322+1 due to registry immutability conflict; no functional changes. CI will be updated to include unique build suffix to avoid tag reuse." Filed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/989 (follow-up: make tags deterministic and unique).

anna: CI fix ticket created as well: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ci/pull/567 (append build.id to release tags).

deploy-bot: Promote started for service-auth tag=release-20260322+1 -> rolling canary to 3% in us-west-2. Audit entry: user=ryan, reason="retag after immutability conflict".

ci-bot: smoke checks: all 3 canary pods returned healthy within 45s.

release-manager: good call. closing the short window at 15:44 PT. Add note to release notes doc /docs/releases/2026-03-22.md. Also pinged release-ops to watch Dedicated customers with pinned tags.

anna: follow ups: - ops to verify replication metrics across regions daily for 24h - ci to merge tag uniqueness PR - infra to add an alert if push returns 412 during release flows

ops-oncall: on it. created alert in PagerDuty rule set.

ryan: reaction :rocket:

release-manager: marking thread resolved. will reopen if any regressions.
